<b>{{PAGENAME}}</B> can be gathered from [[Bee hive|bee hives]] and is used for [[candle]] manufacturing as well as in the [[Alchemy Lab|alchemy laboratory]] for decomposition into reagents.

==Alchemy==
Beeswax can be decomposed into [[slowing solution|solution]] and [[slowing extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
